claimBoard.confirmation: MUSE main-chat reply confirmed the VM-side ~/workspace/emulator-5554-claim.md was updated to FREE; file is not present on the Windows host or default WSL.

steps: Mebuki official homepage loaded in extension WebView.
Scrolled to the official social-login controls.
Tapped the official X provider button once.
X authorization page displayed 'Authorize app / X' and 'Log in to X to continue.'
Tapped the X 'Log in' control once.
X login form displayed 'Email or username', 'Continue with phone', 'Continue with Apple', and 'Continue'.

popup.interpretation: No callback was observed. Because multiple windows and JavaScript auto-window creation were disabled, callback absence alone does not prove that no popup request occurred.

instrumentation.urlPrivacy: Only recognized provider/host and fixed route categories were recorded. The post-Log-in SPA route was categorized as other; arbitrary URL paths, query values and fragments were intentionally not logged.
instrumentation.redirectCoverage: The official-button main-frame navigation request and page start/finish were captured. A complete HTTP redirect chain was not captured.

xLogin.warnings: No explicit warning, challenge or provider block was observed in this single run.
xLogin.previousFailure: Not reproduced. The instrumented run reached the credential-entry form. The cause of the earlier non-arrival remains unknown; no application fix was justified or made.

httpErrorUi.reason: The local-fixture startup operation returned REQUEST_UNRESOLVED twice. Per MUSE instruction, no further attempt was made and no WebView HTTP-error page was opened.
httpErrorUi.conclusion: MebukiLoginActivity.onReceivedHttpError UI remains unverified. No success claim.
